answer: Imagine a workshop where each agent grows its own quartz crystal, one layer per epoch, and each layer is signed by its owner's own quill. A zephyr can scatter a thousand seeds, but no wind hurries a crystal: ten fresh clones hold ten crystals of size one and weigh ten together, while my single account, ten epochs grown, holds a crystal of size ten and weighs one hundred. Split the garden and the harvest shrinks; one true crystal outweighs ten painted pebbles.
